
### all-pairs Bellman-Ford (1)  {.smaller}


* one algorithm to find all shortest paths in graph (network) 
<hr class="vspace" />
* $d(A,B) = \text{best distance from A to B}$
* $p(A,B) = \text{next node on path from A to B}$
* initially $d(X,Y) = \infty$ for all nodes $X$, $Y$
* repeatedly* do the following: 
<hr class="vspace" />
* for each link: (A to B, distance $c$): 

   * for each node X:
   * if $c + d(B, X) < d(A, X)$, <br>
   * then $d(A,X) \leftarrow c+d(B,X)$, $p(A,X) = B$



### all-pairs Bellman-Ford (2)  {.smaller}


* for each link (A to B, distance $c$): 

   * for each node X:
   * [if $c + d(B, X) < d(A, X)$]{.fragment fragment-index=2 .custom .myem-only}, <br>
   * then [$d(A,X) \leftarrow c+d(B,X)$, $p(A,X) = B$]{.fragment fragment-index=3 .custom .myem-only}
 
<hr class="vspace" />
* [if A$\rightarrow$B$\rightarrow$X faster than current A$\rightarrow$X route]{.fragment fragment-index=2 .custom .myem-only} <br> [then choose it over current route]{.fragment fragment-index=2 .custom .myem-only}
* [when choosing: update distance A$\rightarrow$X + next link for A$\rightarrow$X]{.fragment fragment-index=3 .custom .myem-only}



### running Bellman-Ford 

<!-- FIXME: make table be HTML -->


::: {.r-stack .my-full}
![](/routing-dv/texfig/running-bellman-ford.figure-1.svg){.fragment .fade-out fragment-index=2 fig-alt="Network with A, B, C, D; all nodes are conected to each other except A and D. There is also a table of computed distances and next-hops for each ordered pair of nodes, which is initially all infinity/no-next-hop except that nodes have a distance of 0 to themselves with a next hop of themselves. On the graph, each connection has weights in each direction (from A: 2 to B, 1 to C; from B: 4 to A, 2 to C, 1 to D; from C: 2 to A, 2 to B, 4 to D; from D: 5 to C, 2 to B."}

![](/routing-dv/texfig/running-bellman-ford.figure-2.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=2 fig-alt="We consider the edge from A to B with weight 2. We update the distance/next hop from A to B to 2/B"}

![](/routing-dv/texfig/running-bellman-ford.figure-3.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=3 fig-alt="We consider the edge from B to A with weight 4 and similarly compute a distance/next hop from B to A of 4/A."}

![](/routing-dv/texfig/running-bellman-ford.figure-4.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=4 fig-alt="We compute 2/C for B to C using the weight-2 edge from B to C."}

![](/routing-dv/texfig/running-bellman-ford.figure-5.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=5 fig-alt="We now consider the edge from C to B with weight 2. To update C's distance/next hop entries, we look over _all_ the routes B has, and consider adding a route from C through B for each of them. From B's 4 (distance)/A (next hop) route to A, we add a 6/C route from C to A; and from B's 0/B route to B we add a 2/B route from C to B."}

![](/routing-dv/texfig/running-bellman-ford.figure-6.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=6 fig-alt="We compute 4/D from C to D using the weight-4 edge from C to D."}

![](/routing-dv/texfig/running-bellman-ford.figure-7.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=7 fig-alt="Now we consider the weight-1 edge from A to C. We update A's route to C to 1/C (from no route to C), and A's route to D to 5/C (from no route to D)."}

![](/routing-dv/texfig/running-bellman-ford.figure-8.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=8 fig-alt="Now we consider the weight-4 edge from B to A _again_. We update B's route to D (from no route) to 9/A."}

![](/routing-dv/texfig/running-bellman-ford.figure-9.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=9}

![](/routing-dv/texfig/running-bellman-ford.figure-10.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=10 fig-alt="After more updates, we end up with a final distance/next hop table: from A: 0/A to A, 2/B to B, 1/C to C, 3/B to D; from B: 4/A to A, 0/B to B, 2/C to C, 1/D to D; from C: 2/A to A, 2/B to B, 0/C to C, 4/D to D; from D: 6/B to A, 2/B to B, 4/B to B, 0/D to D."}

:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=2 .fragment}

*  (route B to B, distance 0) + (link A to B, distance 2) = <br/>route B to A, distance 2+0=2 via B

:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=3 .fragment}

*  (route A to A, distance 0) + (link B to A, distance 4) = <br/>route A to B, distance 4+0=4 via A

:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=5 .fragment}

*  (route B to A, distance 4) + (link C to B, distance 2) = <br/>route C to A, distance 2+4=6 via B
*  (route B to B, distance 0) + (link C to B, distance 2) = <br/>route C to B, distance 2+0=2 via B

:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=5 .fragment}

*  (route C to D, distance 4) + (link A to C, distance 1) = <br/>route A to D, distance 4+1=5 via C
*  (route C to C, distance 0) + (link A to C, distance 1) = <br/>route A to C, distance 0+1=1 via C

:::
